'''2001 Antwerp Belgian Open''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Antwerp, Belgium on 28 July 2001. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won it. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2813">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ the-european-tour-2001], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Antwerp, Belgium
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 75
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
